sampling_rule.anchor_context_provenance: Declared positive compartment checked against UniProt location or GO cellular-component annotation; U filtering uses subcellular-location text only
sampling_rule.context_filter: Declared broad cellular compartment and equal presence/absence of a UniProt TRANSMEM feature; absence does not prove solubility
sampling_rule.deterministic_key: SHA256(sampling_salt + '|' + target_gene + '|' + anchor_positive_accession + '|' + stratum + '|' + U_accession), smallest hashes first; 50 per group without replacement within target
sampling_rule.eligible: Human, UniProt reviewed, protein-level evidence (existence:1), named primary gene, canonical sequence >=30 residues
sampling_rule.exclusions: All nominated P, query, IntAct human-human partner identifiers including isoforms/secondary accessions, target and reciprocal UniProt subunit annotations, literature exclusions, prior TRAIN/development pairs (P or U), and identical excluded sequences
sampling_rule.gene_display: First primary gene name if an entry has multiple primary gene names
sampling_rule.length_filter: 0.5 to 2.0 times the anchor positive partner's canonical sequence length; no widening was needed
sampling_rule.location_filter: UniProt subcellular-location text before Note=, with evidence braces removed; cytoplasm or cytosol accepted for cytoplasmic context
sampling_rule.row_order: Nominated P first; then 50 context U followed by 50 background U for each P in nominated order
sampling_rule.selection_order: All context groups first, ordered by available candidate count at the twofold length window then anchor accession; background groups next in nominated P order
sampling_rule.sequence_deduplication: Eligible U entries collapsed by canonical sequence SHA-256; lexicographically first eligible accession retained
sampling_rule.task: Nominated biological P-versus-U case-study input, not a new confirmatory benchmark
